Here is my comprehensive report on the search findings.

---

## Search Results: School Year / Semester UserControls

### Key Finding: No Source Code in This Workspace

There are **no source files (.cs) for WinForms UserControls** related to school year ("năm học") or semester ("học kỳ") within the `trung bo` workspace. All such controls are provided by a **compiled external DLL** called `DeclarationManager.dll`, referenced from the project file as:

```
<HintPath>..\bin\Debug\DeclarationManager.dll</HintPath>
```

This DLL's source code does **not** exist anywhere in `G:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12`.

---

### DeclarationManager.Education Controls Used in `trung bo`

Three controls are used for year/semester selection (all from namespace `DeclarationManager.Education`):

#### 1. `UYearSemester` (most commonly used — 40+ forms)
- **Exposed properties** (from usage patterns in code-behind):
  - `YearIDEditValue` — selected year ID (nullable object)
  - `SemesterEditValue` — selected semester value (nullable object, typically 1 or 2)
  - `YearEditValueText` — display text for the selected year (e.g., "2024-2025")
  - `SemesterEditValueInt32` — semester as int? (seen in `frmStudentMarkSummary`)
  - `EditorLeft` — left position of the editor
  - `ReadOnly` — read-only mode flag
  - `Enabled` — enable/disable the control
- **Exposed methods**: `InitData()`, `RefrehData()`, `Reset()`, `IsValidData()`
- **Events**: `EditValueChanged` (delegate: `UYearSemester.EditValueChangedDelegate`)
- **Forms using it**: `frmSubjectMarkDetailOfCourse`, `frmStudent`, `frmThongKeRenLuyen`, `frmQuantityTraining`, `frmSemesterEthicMark`, `frmMonthEthicMark`, `frmEthicStatistic`, `frmSanctionStatistic`, `frmRewardStatistic`, `frmSanctionReview`, `frmExamDate`, `frmMakeGraduationExamSchedule`, `frmRegisterGraduationPractice`, `frmDailySanctionDetail`, `frmDailySanctionList`, `frmDailySanctionMulti`, `frmStudentSocialPolicy`, `frmSubjectMarkDetail`, `frmReviewScholarship`, `frmReviewContinueLearning`, `frmReLearningSummary`, `frmRegisterClassSubject43`, `frmLearningReRegister`, `frmRegisterLogicClass`, `frmLearningSummary`, `frmReRegister`, `frmImportSubjectMark`, `frmDateCheckingMulti`, `frmSessionChecking`, `frmSessionCheckingStatistic`, `frmMonthlyStatistics`, `frmSubjectMarkDetailOfCourse`, and more.

#### 2. `UYear` (year-only — used in ~6 forms)
- **Exposed properties** (from usage):
  - `YearIDEditValue` — selected year ID
- **Events**: `EditValueChanged` (delegate: `UYear.EditValueChangedDelegate`)
- **Forms using it**: `frmStudentStatistic` (as `uYearID`), `frmStudentCollectionStatistic` (as `uYear`), `frmSummaryEthicMark` (as `uYearSemester` — variable misnamed), `frmGraduationSummary` (as `uYearID`), `frmReviewGraduation43` (as `uYearID`), `frmBaoCaoThongKeHocSinh` (as `uYearID`), `frmStudentCollectionQuota` (as `uYearID`), `frmReward` (as `uYear1`).

#### 3. `USemester` (semester-only — used in 1 form)
- **Exposed properties**: Not enough usage to determine — only used in `frmReward` as `uSemester1`.
- **Form using it**: `frmReward`

---

### Other Related `DeclarationManager.Education` Controls Used

| Control Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `UCourseTypeLevel` | Course type & training level selection |
| `USpecialBranch` / `USpecialBranchCheck` | Special branch / major selection |
| `UScienceCourseTypeLevel` / `UScienceCourseTypeLevelCheck` | Science/course/type/level selection |
| `UScienceCourseTypeLevelV` | Variant of above |
| `USubjectGroup` | Subject group selection |

---

### ASP.NET WebForms Versions in Sibling Projects

As a bonus, ASP.NET WebForms versions (`UYearSemester.ascx` / `UYearSemester2.ascx`) exist as **source code** in sibling directories:

- `G:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\quang-binh-2\his\Controls\Sims\UYearSemester.ascx.cs`
- `G:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\quang-binh-2\his\Controls\Sims\UYearSemester2.ascx.cs`
- `G:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\quangbinh-20260622-200657-01\hos-20260622\Controls\Sims\UYearSemester.ascx.cs`
- `G:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12\quangbinh-20260622-200657-01\hos-20260622\Controls\Sims\UYearSemester2.ascx.cs`

These are **not WinForms controls** — they are `System.Web.UI.UserControl` (ASP.NET WebForms) with two DropDownLists: `ddlYearID` and `ddlSemester`, exposing `YearID`, `Semester`, and `YearText` properties. They belong to namespace `InformationWeb.Controls.Sims`.

---

### Conclusion

To get the actual source code of the WinForms `UYearSemester`, `UYear`, and `USemester` controls, you would need to locate the **DeclarationManager source project** (compiled into `DeclarationManager.dll`), which is not present in the `G:\0.CMS-MAIN-ALL-12` directory tree. The DLL is an external dependency referenced by the project at `HintPath ..\bin\Debug\DeclarationManager.dll`.
